walkthroughs.body_html: Ethics is the study of what is right and wrong. People form moral views from their family, friends, religion, laws and their own conscience. Different cultures may agree or disagree on what counts as good.

Most religions teach moral rules: be honest, do not steal, care for others. These guidelines help believers live well and treat others fairly. They often appear in sacred texts like the Bible, Quran or Torah.
A dilemma is when both choices have downsides. Is it right to lie to protect someone? Should you break a promise to do good? Working through dilemmas helps us think carefully about our values.
